payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into how Counterfactual Data Augmentation (CDA) can mitigate gender bias in predictions and improve model performance by equalizing contexts for masculine and feminine terms.

claims.text: Counterfactual Data Augmentation (CDA) mitigates contextual biases by equalizing the representation of masculine and feminine words in training data, leading to fairer predictions.
CDA, when combined with debiased embeddings, significantly improves model performance and reduces gender bias in predictions across various NLP tasks.
Debiasing methods, including CDA, can lead to more equitable outcomes in knowledge bases by addressing discrepancies in model performance related to gender.
